'''The Grinder Dance Hall''' was an entertainment establishment and [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. Offering evening entertainment to the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] community, it was run by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Moira Kruger]] who won control of the establishment after a high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game.<ref name="HNNA" />

The Grinder contained a bar, which served drinks to patrons, and several tables offering games of chance including sabacc, [[sanchango]], and [[hyper-dejarik]]. The criminal [[Themog]] hid out at the Grinder due to his romantic relationship with Lady Kruger.<ref name="HNNA" />
